reasons.plausibility: The general idea that varying elemental content and processing conditions can switch between fcc, hcp, or bcc phases in multi-element alloys is sound, but the text mixes different alloy systems (e.g., Pt–Ru vs. Ta–Nb–V) in a somewhat confusing way.
reasons.testability: Multiple in situ characterization and electrochemical measurements are proposed that could verify or refute the hypothesized phase evolution, but the exact mechanistic link for each system is not clearly distinguished.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a detailed experimental strategy for phase tuning of high-entropy alloys, though conflating different alloy families makes it less straightforward to implement directly.
